about.title: CiteBrand
about.text: CiteBrand is a diagnostic tool for AI search visibility.
about.quote: The diagnostic tool for AI search visibility. Stop guessing, start fixing.

products.title: AI visibility diagnostics
products.text: CiteBrand gives actionable diagnostics for visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.
products.quote: Get actionable diagnostics for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity visibility.

products.title: Source Gap Analysis
products.text: Source Gap Analysis finds the exact URLs where competitors are cited but you are not.
products.quote: Source Gap Analysis Find the exact URLs where competitors are cited but you're not.

products.title: Sentiment Diagnostics
products.text: Sentiment Diagnostics shows why LLMs describe your pricing as expensive or your UX as complex.
products.quote: Sentiment Diagnostics Discover why LLMs think your pricing is "expensive" or UX is "complex".

products.title: Intent Mismatch Detection
products.text: Intent Mismatch Detection shows the content format that wins in AI answers, such as comparison tables instead of blog posts.
products.quote: AI wants comparison tables but you have blog posts? We show the content format that wins.

products.title: Knowledge Graph Check
products.text: Knowledge Graph Check checks whether you are in Wikidata, Google Knowledge Graph and other sources LLMs trust.
products.quote: Are you in Wikidata? Google Knowledge Graph? We check all sources LLMs trust.

products.title: Hallucination Detection
products.text: Hallucination Detection compares LLM answers against your uploaded truth files to find wrong pricing, features, or facts.
products.quote: Upload your truth files. We find every time an LLM gets your pricing, features, or facts wrong.

products.title: Competitor Tracking
products.text: Competitor Tracking shows where competitors appear in AI answers and you don't.
products.quote: Competitor Tracking See exactly where competitors appear and you don't.

plans.title: Free credits
plans.text: New users get 500 free credits and no credit card is required.
plans.quote: No credit card required - 500 free credits included

plans.title: Solo
plans.text: The Solo plan, for freelancers and small agencies, costs $149 per month and includes 2,500 credits per month.
plans.quote: Solo For freelancers and small agencies $149 /month 2,500 credits/month

plans.title: Growth
plans.text: The Growth plan, for growing agencies, costs $499 per month and includes 10,000 credits per month.

plans.title: Subscription billing
plans.text: Subscription fees are billed in advance monthly or annually, and you can cancel at any time.
plans.quote: Subscription fees are billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis You can cancel your subscription at any time
